title: Shadow-to-System
selection_predicate: (cap(Empathy)>=high OR cap(Systems)>=high) AND gap(Sustain/Sys)>0 AND NOT portfolio_has(service_artifact)
render_template: You notice how services fail better than most — but your portfolio doesn’t show you fixing one. Redesign a service you’ve used badly, end to end.

title: Field-to-Form
selection_predicate: cap(Empathy)>=high AND capab(Research)>=evidenced AND readiness(portfolio)<strong AND NOT portfolio_has(researched_product)
evidence: a made artifact traceable to field insight
render_template: Your research is strong, but the line from insight to made object isn’t visible yet. Take one field finding all the way to a built thing.

title: One Object, Ten Ways
evidence: ten physical iterations of one object
render_template: You work things out on screen more than in the hand. Make one object ten different ways — no screens.

title: The Systems Teardown
evidence: a system map + a leverage-point redesign
render_template: Pull a complex system apart, map it, and find the one move that changes the most.

title: Materials Deep-Dive
evidence: a materials study foregrounded in one piece
render_template: Your directions reward material knowledge your work doesn’t show yet. Build one piece where the material is the point.

title: Reframe & Reissue
render_template: Your work is better than the way it’s told. Take your strongest piece and re-tell it so the thinking shows.

title: Studio placement in your domain
relevance_basis: real context in the top domain
evidence: real project shipped in a real studio
render_template: You haven’t worked much in a real {domain} room yet. A placement there is the fastest way to test the fit.

title: Cross-disciplinary collaboration
evidence: a piece built with people outside design
render_template: Your work so far sits inside your own discipline. Build one thing with people who aren’t designers.

title: Ship-It Sprint
evidence: something actually shipped, on a clock
render_template: You’ve lived in ideas but rarely shipped. Take one thing all the way out the door, on a deadline.

title: Fieldwork immersion
gap_metric: say/do gap on Empathy + exposure tier
render_template: Reading people is a bigger part of you than you claim. Spend real time with the people you design for and let it show.

title: The uncomfortable room
relevance_basis: widens the rooms you can work in
evidence: a project done in a room-type you avoid
render_template: You’ve mostly worked in rooms that suit you. Try one that doesn’t — feedback-heavy, or higher-stakes — and see what holds.

title: Sketching reps
render_template: Visualization is a rep game. A short daily sketching habit closes this faster than any course.

title: Digital / interaction foundations
render_template: Your directions lean digital but the toolset isn’t there yet. Build one real interactive thing to close it.

title: Research methods intensive
relevance_basis: you have the instinct, not the method
render_template: You read people well but the method is loose. A structured research intensive turns instinct into rigour.

title: Sustainability & systems literacy
render_template: Your directions reward systems and sustainability thinking. Build the literacy, then apply it once.

title: Making & prototyping bootcamp
render_template: You think with your hands — the skills just aren’t built yet. An intensive closes this fast for you.

title: Materials & manufacturing (DFM)
relevance_basis: a domain-critical skill in your top domain
render_template: Manufacturing knowledge is critical in your top domain and thin in your work. Close it with a focused DFM course.
